findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: series · Private data: rate_history, series, bank_position, bank_analysis · Public sink: rate_history, series, yield_curve.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: series · Private data: rate_history, series, bank_position, bank_analysis · Public sink: rate_history, series, yield_curve

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
